Contact us

På svenska

Here you will find contact details and links to information about where to turn with questions relating to studies, collaboration, finances and emergencies, among other things.

The University's contact information

The University switchboard is usually open from 8:00 to 16:30 on weekdays. However, on certain occasions such as working day between holidays, it closes earlier.

Telephone (switchboard):
+46 (0)46 222 00 00

Postal address:
Lund University
Box 117, SE-221 00
Lund, Sweden

Visiting address: 
Visit Lund University – how to get here

Further contact details:

The University Records Management

The University Records Management provides information on matters such as the handling and registration of public documents.

The University Records Management is open on weekdays from 09:00 to 11:30. During working days between public holidays the opening ours are 09:30 to 11:30.

Telephone: 046-222 71 40
Email: registrator [at] lu [dot] se 
Visiting address: Arkivcentrum syd, Porfyrvägen 20, Lund

Questions about registration and transcript of records

For course registration questions, contact your department at the university. If you are unsure who to contact, call the university switchboard at 046-222 00 00.

For transcripts from Ladok or study verification, contact the International Desk. See contact details under "Questions about studying at Lund University"

University Archives

The University Archives provides help with retrieving public records from the central archives.

The University Archives is open on weekdays from 9:00 to 11:30.

Telephone: 046-222 16 70
Email: universitetsarkivet [at] legal [dot] lu [dot] se (universitetsarkivet[at]legal[dot]lu[dot]se)
Visiting address: Arkivcentrum syd, Porfyrvägen 20, Lund

Questions about studying at Lund University

If you have questions about studies or student life, you are welcome to contact us online or visit our International Desk. 

Course registration 

For course registration questions, contact your department at the university. If you are unsure who to contact, call the university switchboard at 046-222 00 00.

Transcript of records

If you are no longer a student at Lund University, please email the International Desk at 
studentreception [at] lu [dot] se (studentreception[at]lu[dot]se) to request a transcript of records, or call them on
+46 (0)46 222 01 00. 

Current students can access their study details in Ladok.

General questions about studies and student life

International Desk:

Email: studentreception [at] lu [dot] se
Telephone: +46 (0)46 222 01 00
Visiting address: Forum Medicum, Building E, Sölvegatan 19.

In case of emergency

Ambulance, fire brigade, police – in emergency situations on campus/in Sweden, call 112 (or 0-112 if you are calling from your office landline).

The University's emergency number: +46 (0)46 222 07 00

Please see our student and staff pages for other important contact details and information on how to report an incident.
